prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final scrolling background plate for a 2D side-scrolling beat-em-up, extremely wide landscape 3:1 panoramic composition, ideally 3072x1024. RockStreet, first mission EL GARAGE in Barrio Sur of Neon City 1986. A huge old industrial garage converted into the rehearsal space of a rock band, recently vandalized by punk fanatics. Cinematic painted realism matching gritty 1980s rock cover illustration, believable brick, concrete, leather and metal. CAMERA: side-on architectural elevation, wall parallel to screen, no vanishing point toward center, no corridor into distance, no top-down view; slight downward view of broad foreground floor like Streets of Rage. Back wall occupies upper 60% of image; bottom 40% is continuous unobstructed dark worn concrete combat floor with subtle cyan and amber reflections. All tall scenery and debris stay behind the wall-floor line at 60% height. No steps, railings or equipment in the foreground walking area.
Along rear wall: battered rehearsal amplifiers, a drum kit with displaced cymbal, speaker stacks, a red empty guitar stand, ripped unlettered gig posters, punk paint marks without words, knocked-over road cases safely in background, torn acoustic panels. Metal roll-up garage doors and repeating brick pillars. Near far right a small low rehearsal stage entirely in back wall band for punk boss arena. Warm overhead industrial lamps, restrained cyan and magenta light spilling from workshop windows, light haze in upper areas only. Clearly a rock band's garage, intimate gritty punk atmosphere, no nightclub luxury, no modern LED screens. Left and right outer edges both end in dark matching brick/concrete so mirrored repeats form a coherent long room. Floor texture equally dark at both ends and horizontal floor line consistent across entire panorama.
No characters, no silhouettes, no readable text, no UI, no logo, no watermark. Opaque full bleed environment, sharp game-ready background.
